swagger.lifecycle.deprecatedHint: This API is deprecated. Use a current API for new integrations and plan to migrate existing callers.
swagger.lifecycle.sunsetHint: This API is retiring soon. Avoid new integrations and migrate existing callers. Refer to service announcements for the shutdown date.
swagger.exportAll: Select APIs to export to InnerTOP
swagger.exportRemedy.version: Set Version to a valid YYYY-MM-DD date matching the Action suffix. Export APIs with different versions separately.
swagger.exportRemedy.type: Ask the API maintainer to declare explicit types and object fields. Supported types are String, Integer, Long, Float, Double, Boolean, Struct and their one-dimensional arrays. Regenerate and reload OpenAPI, then retry.
swagger.exportRemedy.response: Ask the API maintainer to define the actual success Result as an object with fixed fields and document it in OpenAPI. Scalar, array or arbitrary JSON responses require an API change first. Regenerate and reload OpenAPI, then retry.
swagger.exportRemedy.unsupported: Ask the API maintainer to provide a working Action API with a date suffix and a fixed Action query parameter in OpenAPI. Regenerate and reload the contract.
swagger.exportRemedy.schema: Ask the API maintainer to fix missing or unresolved Schema references, then regenerate and reload OpenAPI.
swagger.exportRemedy.dynamic: Ask the API maintainer to provide a fixed-field contract for the indicated object. Arbitrary key-value data requires an API with a fixed structure first; removing dynamic field annotations alone is insufficient. Regenerate and reload OpenAPI.
swagger.exportRemedy.nestedArray: Ask the API maintainer to replace the multidimensional array with a one-dimensional array of objects whose fields describe the inner data. Update the actual API and OpenAPI, then regenerate and reload the contract.
swagger.exportRemedy.location: This template supports only Query, Body(Form) and Body(JSON). Ask the API maintainer to provide an actual supported parameter location and update OpenAPI; required Header or Path parameters cannot simply be omitted.
swagger.exportRemedy.body: Ask the API maintainer to define the actual JSON body as an object with fixed, typed fields in OpenAPI. Array or scalar bodies require an API change first. Regenerate and reload the contract.
swagger.exportRemedy.emptyResponse: Ask the API maintainer to document the actual HTTP 200 response and its Schema. If the API has no response body, provide an integration API returning a standard Result first, then regenerate and reload OpenAPI.
swagger.exportRemedy.versionRoute: Ask the API maintainer to register a date-suffixed Action, such as {{detail}}20230101, and verify that Action={{detail}} with Version=2023-01-01 reaches it. Regenerate and reload OpenAPI. Changing Version in this dialog alone cannot satisfy this condition.
swagger.exportHint: Generate InnerTOP JSON from Action contracts. Only fully representable APIs can be exported; blocked APIs show the reason and how to enable export.
swagger.routesHint: The form defaults to BOE routes. Set PublicPathPrefix to the gateway prefix; the operation’s Path is generated automatically.

swagger.protocolHint.innertop: Action / Version identifies the operation; authentication follows its contract. Requests here call the current service directly; export configuration for gateway integration.
swagger.protocolRule.rest: The contract has no fixed Action. Authentication does not determine the operation protocol.
swagger.protocolRule.innertop: The contract declares an Action route or a fixed Action query parameter. Credentials are defined separately.
swagger.actionDispatch: The backend resolves to {{action}}. In split mode, it appends Version with dashes removed to Action.
swagger.headerPrecedence:
An operation-specific header overrides the shared setting with the same name.

Credentials and automatic time headers are still generated according to the operation contract.

swagger.authorizationTypesHint:
Basic Auth and Bearer Token are built in. You can also configure a named authorization type with custom headers.

The contract defines an operation’s declared authorization types; new types are available only as per-operation overrides. Credentials stay in the current page’s memory.
swagger.authorizationOverrideHint:
The selected type applies only to this request and determines the generated authorization header.

The server decides whether the operation accepts it. Changing the type does not change the operation’s authentication requirements.

swagger.customAuthScope: These credentials only apply to this operation. Empty credentials are not injected; turn off automatic authentication separately.
